admission.reason: Named complete port/descriptor/control/slot and finite bank-grant contracts must finish G0; then RTL may be written before physical closure. SS/FF in actualparent required for adoption.

area.reserve_basis: State+clock master-body FLOOR only; mux/select/credit/reset/epoch/control cells, pin escape/PG/routing and HE/CROM adapters charged separately. No speculative removal or embedded credit.

construction.CKV: Epicurus owns full512ready/gen/immutable lease successor. Boundary exports actual generation, accepted RX/staging, nine owner-visiblewrite ACKs and engine/output retirement. No mergerdone/producerempty/TXaccept as physical drain.
construction.bridge: Preselect source payload into dedicated source-clock FF; unconditional destination-clock input FF; queue/feedback/mux only inside destination domain. Direct crossing has no4:1array mux or enable-feedback mux. All data/control/credit crossings timed SS60/FF25 at full related clocks; no multicycle/phase exception.
construction.common_PLL: 3.6GHz /3,/4 phase relation must be parent-source bound
construction.control: Atomic decoded command members from source per-engine ports, transaction16 + epoch32; no direct cross-clock go pulse, ready/idle/fault/argmax/completion. Command and visible completion reverse channels required.
construction.field_activation: ROM loader advances ld_k/ld_pos only on request accept; rq_* and quantizer metadata on matched reply-valid. Keep original have/s_ok/parity reuse and rounding. Dedicated64-element snapshot port, current one-cycle contract explicitly changed behind default-off.
construction.field_result: ARreserve64rows/root*64roots raw69-bit entries BEFORE go; existing immutable stride256 bounds every symbolic phase. Capture accepts every source root result regardless of slow VM backpressure; new phase/reuse blocked until visibleACK drains all roots. No average-arrival assumption or full-return138469120-bit credit.

stream: pooled index scan and HBM endpoints
BF16 selector fast subtree; Engram remains current X_EG0 path

construction.pointer: Credit updates are registered source/destination full-clock paths, not combinational ready crosses. Overflow traps; new transaction cannot consume prior epoch reply.
construction.reset: Stop new admissions -> drain accepted requests and actual visible writes/engine outputs -> exchange empty+retired epoch receipts -> flush local queues -> synchronize reset release in each domain -> latch fresh externally monotonic epoch32 -> exchange ready -> reopen. Forced reset aborts prior epoch and quarantines late service replies; no one-sided pointer reset or epoch reuse.
construction.rhythm: F2S acceptance limited3/4 fast edges and S2F3/3 chain edges, <=0.9Gsame-width packets/s. Phase-qualified valid/credits require common reset alignment; no single-clock proof. Backpressure through8finite seats, no perpetual4/3rate preservation claim.
construction.stalled_bound: For each reserved endpoint eight packets imply <=8 destination service cycles plus launch/capture/local queues, provided explicit grant/ready guarantee. Existing sources offer no universal finite consumer stall guarantee; external HBM/peer waits remain bound by their owner calendar, and timeout is fault, not successful completion.

latency.composed_token_extension: Join at each source issue/read/return/visible completion graph event; do not sum1149calls serially or substitute modeled4/5for stalledservice.
latency.historical_fixed4_5_replaced_by: Per-edge launch/capture, accepted-request/response queues, bank service and actual visibleACK; source/load/return loops all composed.
